story.ch06.title: The Borrowed Sky
story.ch06.summary: Survive the Core trial, end Shen’s service, and choose how the river will be kept.
story.ch06.s01.title: Before the First Strike
story.ch06.s01.objective: Prepare for the Golden Core trial: complete all three Foundation ranks and clear the Ashen Guardian.
story.ch06.s01.lan: Mei ran a path through floodwater so people could reach higher ground. I kept hearing that as an order to close every gate forever. She left routes, not orders for the rest of our lives.
story.ch06.s01.apprentice: We will use the routes and read the water. Fear belongs in the calculation; it cannot be the whole calculation.
story.ch06.s01.lan2: Then keep your feet under you. The shell has held on too long; it will call every change a threat. You have to last through the storm before you can break it.
story.ch06.s01.requirements: Trial entry: Foundation ranks 1–3 complete; Ashen Guardian first clear banked. Entry costs nothing. Missing progression can be earned on regular expeditions.
story.ch06.s01.optional: Shared-stewardship tasks remain optional. You can finish them now, or return to this hub from the final decision screen after winning the trial.
story.ch06.s01.stay: Stay at the sanctuary and prepare.
story.ch06.s01.journal: The trial is free and has no campaign countdown. Survive all three storm phases, then disable the Broken Guardian’s defensive shell. Defeat preserves banked resources, completed realms, and all story evidence.
story.ch06.s02.title: The Shell That Cannot Stop
story.ch06.s02.objective: Survive all storm phases, then break the governor’s defensive shell.
story.ch06.s02.phase1: The first surge follows the metal paths. Look for the outline before you look for the sky.
story.ch06.s02.warn: Marked ground. Move clear before the strike lands.
story.ch06.s02.phase2: The pressure is crossing the cooled channel. Keep moving between the marked strikes; do not trust an unmarked shadow to hide you.
story.ch06.s02.phase3: Last surge. Breathe after you step, not while you are standing in the ring.
story.ch06.s02.shell: Reserve threatened. Preserve governor. Reject replacement.
story.ch06.s02.shen_shell: I am requesting the replacement. The shell is refusing it. Strike when its guard opens.
story.ch06.s02.recovery: Its guard is open. This is your chance.
story.ch06.s02.victory: The command is gone. I can hear the river without being ordered to hold it. Keep the bridge a little longer.
story.ch06.s02.failed: The storm overwhelmed your bridge. Retry from preparation or return to the sanctuary. No banked items, completed realms, or story evidence are lost.
story.ch06.s02.retry: Retry the full Golden Core trial. Storm phases and the shell restart together; completed optional tasks remain complete.
story.ch06.s02.journal: The defensive shell is disabled and the Golden Core breakthrough is achieved. Shen remains able to speak while the Core briefly bridges the circuit. Ending his service is the next required step, before any river-system choice.
story.ch06.s03.title: No More Renewals
story.ch06.s03.objective: Discharge the service bindings and release Shen Heng.
story.ch06.s03.apprentice: The shell is broken. I can discharge the binding without dropping the stored water at once. Is this still what you want?
story.ch06.s03.shen: Yes. End the service. Keep the terms and my answer where the next keeper can read them. Do not keep me in their place.
story.ch06.s03.control: Original term: thirty days. Current service: thirteen years. Defensive loop: disabled. Living guardian requests release. Discharge is safe under the temporary Core bridge.
story.ch06.s03.lan: No extension. No empty handover field. Shen Heng, your watch is over.
story.ch06.s03.shen2: I used to know which footsteps belonged to which worker. For years, I only heard the gate. I would like the last sound to be water going somewhere.
story.ch06.s03.apprentice2: It is moving through the outlet. There is no command left for you to hold.
story.ch06.s03.farewell: Then let it go. And when you make the next promise, write down when it ends.
story.ch06.s03.status: Shen Heng’s service has ended. His living pattern has dissolved; no copy of his mind remains. The archive preserves only records of his words; it cannot summon him, question him, or restore his body.
story.ch06.s03.journal: Release completed before the replacement decision. Every ending honors Shen’s final consent and refusal to serve as an echo. The temporary Core bridge allows a safe, paused decision; taking time in the menu does not harm the valley.
story.ch06.s03.skip: Shen confirmed his request. You ended his thirteen-year service before choosing a replacement. His farewell and the discharge record are available in the journal.
story.ch06.s04.title: What You Agree to Keep
story.ch06.s04.objective: Review every outcome, then confirm one replacement or return to prepare.
story.ch06.s04.lan: There is no way to leave the mountain exactly as it was. We can reopen it, retire it, or share the work. Read the duties as carefully as the benefits.
story.ch06.s04.open_preview: Reopen the balanced cycle. Lower-valley flow returns sooner. Your Golden Core becomes the temporary governor, and you commit to seasonal checks while a shared network is built. The mountain retains cultivation flow, but the ongoing burden is concentrated in you. You can travel and train; you cannot treat maintenance as finished. Shen remains released. No additional side-task requirement.
story.ch06.s04.seal_preview: Drain the remaining reservoir under Core control, then retire the mountain intake. No sudden reservoir release occurs. The sanctuary loses its former spiritual abundance and becomes a place of teaching and ordinary work. Lower-valley households use Yun’s prepared alternative channels and relocation sites; some journeys become longer and familiar land must be left. Your Core is freed after the drain; you help the transition rather than serve as permanent governor. Shen remains released. No additional side-task requirement.
story.ch06.s04.shared_preview: Reopen through the verified spillway and agreed seasonal allocation. Named maintenance crews accept inspections, gate work, and review dates. Your Core bridges commissioning for no more than three days, then ceases to be the sole ongoing governor. Mountain and valley share flow and labor; shortages, future disputes, and regular repairs remain possible. The agreement can be revised openly, not silently renewed. Shen remains released. Requires Spillway Verified, Allocation Agreed, and Handover Accepted.
story.ch06.s04.spillway_ready: Spillway Verified: complete. The route and release marks are recorded.
story.ch06.s04.spillway_missing: Spillway Verified: not complete. Return to the sanctuary and follow the spillway task in your journal.
story.ch06.s04.allocation_ready: Allocation Agreed: complete. Seasonal limits and shortage review are recorded.
story.ch06.s04.allocation_missing: Allocation Agreed: not complete. Return to the sanctuary and finish the allocation task in your journal.
story.ch06.s04.handover_ready: Handover Accepted: complete. Named maintainers and the first review date are recorded.
story.ch06.s04.handover_missing: Handover Accepted: not complete. Return to the sanctuary and finish the handover task in your journal.
story.ch06.s04.confirm_warning: Confirming commits this campaign’s ending once. Your save, achievements, journal, and reconstructed training expeditions remain available. A different ending requires New Game. Cancel to keep reviewing, or return to the sanctuary to finish optional tasks.
story.ch06.s04.confirm_open_text: Confirm Open River: I accept temporary Core regulation and seasonal maintenance while a shared network is rebuilt.
story.ch06.s04.confirm_seal_text: Confirm Quiet Summit: I accept retiring the intake, draining safely, and helping households move to the prepared alternatives.
story.ch06.s04.confirm_shared_text: Confirm Returning Rain: I accept the verified route, agreed allocation, and named shared-maintenance handover.
story.ch06.s04.return: Return to the sanctuary before deciding.
story.ch06.s04.return_notice: Trial victory and Shen’s release are saved. Finish optional tasks at the sanctuary, then use the decision marker to return to the quiet arena. The storm trial will not restart.
story.ch06.s04.journal: All three replacements end Shen’s service. Open River restores flow with your temporary seasonal burden. Quiet Summit retires the intake and uses prepared alternatives. Returning Rain reopens under verified shared duties. Ending commitment is irreversible within this campaign, but only after explicit confirmation.
